confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge and the supplied reference prices; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Porto is set modestly below Lisbon for food, drink and most lodging. Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors are the firmest; July hostel and hotel rates are the most volatile. Beer assumes a 0.5 L draught, as in the references. Cocktail (about 3x beer) and wine glass (about 1.3x beer) are derived from the beer anchor because direct Porto knowledge is weaker. The FX figure came from web search summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page, not a directly opened table, and the page metadata looked stale; verify it against the live RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lisbon is the closest comparable (same country, similar tourism demand), with Porto set modestly below it for food, drink and most lodging. Madrid is a secondary Iberian cross-check for beer, hostel and hotel levels. Reykjavik was not used as a close comparable because its price level is far higher.
